'''Tiana Fortune''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Fortune's Loss''' in the permit-locked '''Achenar''' system. A former Imperial Guard officer with a talent for electronic engineering, she specialises in scanners, sensors, limpet controllers, and related utility modules.<ref name="edwiki-tiana">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Tiana_Fortune Tiana Fortune], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Tiana provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for eight module families. She also offers Grade 3 engineering for the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] and [[Frame Shift Drive Interdictor]], plus Grade 4 Extended [[Cargo Rack]] engineering in Live.<ref name="inara-tiana">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/16/ Tiana Fortune — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Achenar
* '''Facility:''' Fortune's Loss
* '''Allegiance:''' Empire
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship scanners, sensors, limpet controllers, and utility modules
* '''Referral required:''' [[Hera Tani]]
* '''System permit required:''' Yes — the Achenar permit requires Imperial Navy rank Squire or higher<ref name="edwiki-tiana" />

== Access requirements ==

Access to Tiana Fortune requires:<ref name="inara-tiana" /><ref name="edwiki-tiana" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Hera Tani]] to receive her referral.
# Reach '''Friendly reputation with the Empire'''.
# Obtain the '''Achenar permit''', which requires Imperial Navy rank Squire or higher.
# Provide '''50 units of Decoded Emission Data''' at Fortune's Loss.

Decoded Emission Data is an Encoded Engineering Material rather than cargo. The complete ordered process, including Imperial rank progression and material acquisition, belongs to [[Unlocking Tiana Fortune]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Tiana Fortune increases by:<ref name="inara-tiana" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling commodities at Fortune's Loss.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Tiana supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-tiana" />

The available conventional modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add two Operations-era services to Tiana's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-tiana" />

* '''Extended''' [[Cargo Rack]] engineering through Grade 4<ref name="inara-extended">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/206/ Cargo Rack — Extended], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Long Range Detailed''' [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] engineering through Grade 3<ref name="inara-long-range">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Exact modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Tiana Fortune blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade she offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Current Engineer records do not identify another Engineer whose discovery requirement comes directly from Tiana Fortune. Her active referral branch therefore ends at her workshop.<ref name="inara-tiana" />
